Apple is rolling out support for Apple Wallet driver’s license integration to a new state. Starting today, Oklahoma residents can add their license to the Wallet app on iPhone and Apple Watch for easy mobile access.

Apple Wallet driver’s license support expands to new state

To add your license to your iPhone, tap the plus icon in the upper-right corner of the Apple Wallet app. You’ll then need to scan the front and back of your license and verify your identity to complete the process.

Oklahoma is the 16th state in the United States to launch support for Apple Wallet driver’s licenses. The feature was first announced at WWDC in 2021 and has slowly expanded across the country since then.

The expansion to Oklahoma, which was first spotted by MacRumors, comes just a week after the feature launched in Virginia. Multiple other states are working on support for Apple Wallet licenses, including Kentucky, Utah, Connecticut, Mississippi, and North Carolina.

You can use Apple Wallet licenses at TSA checkpoints at more than 250 airports, plus select other businesses and venues.

You can view the full list of states that accept digital driver’s licenses in Apple Wallet here:

Regardless of what state you live in, there’s still a way to add a version of your ID to Apple Wallet. Apple launched a new Digital ID feature last year powered by your US passport. This lets you create a digital version of your passport to use at TSA checkpoints.

Have you ever used the driver’s license or Digital ID features in Apple Wallet? How was that experience? Let us know down in the comments.
